classModifierTokensNotAdmitted.reason: RULING R-8 excludes state and modifier classes from part admission. These are measured and recorded so the evidence survives, but they are NOT parts and are NOT written into the enforced `states` or `variantAxes` arrays: R-5 classifies data-attribute tokens, and the owner has not extended it to BEM modifier classes. Under-claiming is the safe error.

surfaceSkinBinding.law: A surface carries no CSS under `ui/surfaces/`. Its paint lives in a dedicated skin bound by the root pair plus BEM elements and data-part, so those class pairs are part anchors under RULING R-8 (b).
